title: Disagreement dossier (machine-checkable extract)
description: JSON sidecar for units/<UID>/disagreement.md. Prepared for the Phase-7 Socratic gate. MUST present >=2 options; the validator additionally enforces the invariant that EXACTLY ONE option is marked recommended.

origin.description: 1.14.0 adds a FOURTH literal, `requirement-starvation` (I56, Drift fix 4): a DoD item that has gone N consecutive non-shipping units with nothing shipped, put to the human as a three-way trade through the EXISTING Phase-7 path. This is ADDITIVE — every dossier already on disk carries one of the three original literals and stays valid. Filing starvation under `criteria-conflict` was explicitly REJECTED: that would widen an enum's meaning silently.
